text:
Mayor Cherelle Parker signed her city budget bills into law on Thursday after they received final approval from City Council.

It has been something of a winding road to get here, but on Thursday, Philadelphia City Council approved Mayor Cherelle Parker's nearly $7 billion budget plan.

The mayor signed her Fiscal Year 2027 Budget bills into law at 3:30 p.m. at City Hall.

The approval comes just hours after the mayor announced a plan to save hundreds of school district jobs from cuts that could have been implemented -- though, just where the needed funds will come from has not yet been detailed.

The plan's passage also comes after months of discussion as certain elements of the proposal -- notably several new taxes proposed by the mayor -- proved to be sticking points for some legislators.
